title: Departments - Town of Huntington
key_finding: The Town's departments page lists Public Safety and Maritime Services, but not a Town of Huntington police department.

title: Security Division - Town of Huntington
key_finding: Huntington describes Security Division patrol of Town facilities, park-ranger peace-officer activity, and parking / town-code complaint handling rather than general municipal policing.

title: 2020 Tentative Budget - Public Safety
key_finding: The Town budget says Public Safety consists of Security, Park Ranger, Code Enforcement, Animal Control, and Special Services divisions, which is not the structure of a general town police department.

title: Huntington Bay Constables - Town of Huntington
key_finding: The Town says Bay Constables are peace officers specializing in marine and conservation law enforcement, confirming a narrow harbor function rather than a general town police force.

title: About Huntington - Town of Huntington
key_finding: The Town says Huntington contains four incorporated villages plus multiple unincorporated areas, so it is not a single undivided municipal service surface.

title: Incorporated Villages - Town of Huntington
key_finding: The Town lists four incorporated villages within Huntington: Asharoken, Huntington Bay, Lloyd Harbor, and Northport.

title: Public Safety
key_finding: Suffolk County says the Suffolk County Police Department provides all police services for the five western towns including Huntington and also serves western-town incorporated villages that maintain their own police departments.

title: Second Precinct
key_finding: The 2nd Precinct states that it serves the residents of the Town of Huntington, supporting county primary responsibility for general policing.

title: Police Department - Village of Northport
key_finding: Northport's official police page lists an active village police department with a chief, lieutenant, sergeants, detectives, and patrol officers.

title: Huntington Bay Police
key_finding: Huntington Bay's official police page states that the village has its own police headquarters and police officers handling emergencies and non-emergency police matters.

title: About Huntington Bay Village
key_finding: Huntington Bay says it maintains its own accredited police force led by a police chief.

title: Police Department - Village of Lloyd Harbor
key_finding: Lloyd Harbor says it has a thirteen-person police department that provides twenty-four hour police protection.
